entries.zh: 安守本分；凡事持之以恒
entries.en: to keep to one's proper station and duty; to persevere steadfastly in everything
entries.notes: 西语栏讹（los perseveranca），与「安本分」义不尽合，取汉字为主、西义附后。

entries.zh: 敛嘴（守口）；言语、吃食皆谨慎不外露
entries.en: to guard one's mouth in speaking and eating; to keep silent, be discreet

entries.zh: 留心（谨守其心，记挂在心）
entries.en: to keep one's heart/mind; to bear in mind, be attentive
entries.notes: 「晋/晉」字形与音 liū 不合，疑实为「留心」，据音义推断。

entries.zh: 把占（抓住占据；谨存于心）
entries.en: to hold fast and keep for oneself; (perh.) to keep as a remembrance
entries.notes: 「把占」与西语义 guardarse este recuerdo（存念不忘）对应不明，释义系推断。

entries.zh: 藏话（把话藏住不说，守口保密）
entries.en: to hide one's words; to keep a secret

entries.zh: 藏听（把听来的话藏住，不外传）
entries.en: to conceal what one has heard; to keep it secret
entries.notes: 第二字作「聽」而音读 chām 不合（或为「讒」），据西语与「藏」字定其义。

entries.zh: 把听到的话藏住不说（守密）
entries.en: to keep heard words secret; to conceal speech
entries.notes: M 栏末多出一名 1oy（ōi?）与 H 四字不合，字形存疑；大意据西语与「藏聽言語」。

entries.zh: 潜养（暗中包藏，蓄而不露）
entries.en: to harbor secretly; to keep (a secret) hidden

entries.zh: 含忍（把话咽住，忍而不发）
entries.en: to bear silently; to keep a matter to oneself
to keep with care; to guard attentively
entries.notes: 「却智」二字组合费解，释义主要据西语 guardar con cuydados。

entries.en: to store away in a place; to keep, stash
to put away and hide somewhere
entries.notes: 「到起藏」组合费解（cò quy），据西语与「藏」字推断。

entries.zh: 把物收定，过后再寻出（收好待取）
entries.en: to put a thing away and find it again later
entries.notes: 「定乙物」之「乙」费解、两「定」连用亦奇，据西语与「物」字推断。

entries.zh: 怀藏（藏于怀中，随身掩藏）
entries.en: to conceal, carry hidden (in one's bosom)

entries.zh: 敛身（退隐自守，避而不出）
entries.en: to keep oneself withdrawn/hidden; to shun view, keep out of sight
entries.notes: 首字「歛/欽」存疑（音 liām 合「歛」），取「敛身」退隐义；西语兼指 guardarse 与 huir。

entries.zh: 把守（看守、守卫）；卫兵、哨兵
entries.en: to keep watch over, guard; a guard, sentry

entries.zh: 上闩（把门闩住）；（或指告解亭之门闩）
entries.en: to bolt/bar (a door); (perh.) the bolt of a confessional
entries.notes: 西语栏残讹（末词 atron 不明），与「把閂」对应存疑，仅据字形与告解语境推断。

entries.zh: 随船管护者（船上管事，司看护装载）
entries.en: ship's keeper (guardián of the vessel, officer in charge of stowage)
entries.notes: 首字「綜/縺」存疑、音 cóy 与「公」不合，释义主要据西语（马尼拉大帆船语境）。

entries.zh: 裱褙（装裱字画、镶边加固）
entries.en: to mount and back pictures (framing with border)
